item.description:
Welcome to The Unwritten Code!

Have you ever received a Venmo request for $2.47 from a friend and wondered if modern society is completely broken? Or sat trapped in a twelve-person family group chat wishing there was an emergency eject button?

Join co-hosts Maya Lin and Julian Cross as they unpack life's unspoken rules—from office Slack anxiety and first-date economics to airport etiquette and roommate wars.

  • Weekday Mornings: 6–8 minute quick-hit daily dilemmas with your morning coffee.
  • The Weekend Docket (Saturdays): 15-minute trials resolving listener-submitted confessions and moral dilemmas.

Official Launch: Monday, October 5th, 2026. Hit Follow on Spotify or Apple Podcasts right now!
